Madhya Pradesh Faces Power Crisis Amidst Heatwave

Madhya Pradesh is experiencing a significant power crisis, with some areas facing 8 to 10 hours of daily power outages, while villages remain in darkness overnight. Protests and road blockades have occurred in Bhopal, Sehore, and Betul due to the outages. There is hope for relief as an additional 4,000 megawatts of electricity may become available next week.
